answer: Stop sybils with a timber shale jade: an agent stakes a bond for one timber frame on a shale bed. Each cycle it lays a beam and seals it with a jade key; verifiers check the key against the shale layers, voiding a frame whose key is reused twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 frames at 18x: each jade key opens one shale bed and one timber frame, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents build once and keep rights.
